title: Workers' Compensation Referral Program Rate Schedule
content:
# Workers' Compensation Referral — Program Rate Schedule

Every program offered under the Workers' Compensation Referral is priced on a single fee basis: either the North Carolina Industrial Commission medical fee schedule, or the employer's own direct-pay contract. The schedule below sets, for each program, the unit in which treatment is billed, the rate for one billing unit, the rate for the initial evaluation, the carrier network discount and the most billing units that may be billed for one date of service.

## Schedule of rates by program

| Program | Fee basis | Billing unit | Unit rate | Evaluation rate | Network discount | Maximum billable units per date of service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Employer Direct Early Intervention | Employer direct-pay contract | Visit | $85.00 | $0.00 | 0 percent | 1 visit |
| Workers' Comp Outpatient Therapy | NC Industrial Commission medical fee schedule | Visit | $142.00 | $168.00 | 5 percent | 1 visit |
| Workers' Comp Post-Surgical Therapy | NC Industrial Commission medical fee schedule | Visit | $156.00 | $168.00 | 5 percent | 1 visit |
| Work Conditioning Program | NC Industrial Commission medical fee schedule | Hour | $64.00 | $168.00 | 5 percent | 4 hours |
| Work Hardening Program | NC Industrial Commission medical fee schedule | Hour | $64.00 | $196.00 | 5 percent | 8 hours |
| Functional Capacity Evaluation | NC Industrial Commission medical fee schedule | Hour | $145.00 | $0.00 | 0 percent | 4 hours |

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Fee basis** — how the program's charges are priced: the state fee schedule of the North Carolina Industrial Commission, or the employer's direct-pay contract.
- **Billing unit** — the unit in which treatment is billed: a visit or an hour.
- **Unit rate** — the billed rate for one billing unit of treatment, in US dollars to the cent.
- **Evaluation rate** — the billed rate for the initial evaluation; $0.00 where the program has no separate evaluation charge.
- **Network discount** — the discount, as a whole percentage of the billed amount, that the carrier's workers' compensation network takes at payment; 0 percent where there is none.
- **Maximum billable units per date of service** — the most billing units billed for one date of service, counted in the program's billing unit.

## Reading the schedule

**Which programs are billed by the hour?** Work Conditioning Program, Work Hardening Program and Functional Capacity Evaluation; the other three programs are billed by the visit.

**Which programs carry no separate evaluation charge?** Employer Direct Early Intervention and Functional Capacity Evaluation, both listed at $0.00.

**Which program is priced under an employer contract rather than the state fee schedule?** Only Employer Direct Early Intervention.

**Which programs carry no network discount?** Employer Direct Early Intervention and Functional Capacity Evaluation, both at 0 percent; the other four programs list 5 percent.

**Do Work Conditioning and Work Hardening share a unit rate?** Yes, both list $64.00 per hour; they differ in evaluation rate ($168.00 and $196.00) and in billable hours per date of service (4 and 8).
